findings.title: EC2 instance without IMDSv2 enforcement
findings.description: Without metadata_options.http_tokens = "required", the instance metadata service accepts IMDSv1 requests, which SSRF vulnerabilities can abuse to steal credentials.

findings.title: EC2 instance without detailed monitoring
findings.description: With monitoring absent or false (the provider default), the instance ships only basic 5-minute CloudWatch metrics, delaying detection of performance and availability issues.

findings.title: Secrets in EC2 user_data
findings.description: A secret (AWS key, password, token) embedded in EC2 user_data is visible in the console, API responses, and instance metadata. user_data_base64 is decoded before scanning. Pass secrets via instance profiles, SSM Parameter Store, or Secrets Manager instead. The secret value is never included in findings. Interpolated references to secret-like variables (${var.db_password}) are also reported: user_data is visible in the console regardless of variable sensitivity.
findings.expected: no secrets in user_data; use instance profiles or SSM/Secrets Manager
findings.remediation:
Remove secrets from user_data immediately and rotate every exposed value.
Pass secrets via instance tags + Secrets Manager lookup at boot, or use an IAM
instance profile so the instance fetches secrets at runtime:
user_data = base64encode(templatefile("bootstrap.sh", {}))  # no secrets inside
Note: user_data is visible to anyone with EC2 DescribeInstances — treat any
secret ever placed there as compromised.

findings.title: EC2 instance without termination protection
findings.description: disable_api_termination is absent or false, so the instance can be terminated by an accidental or malicious API call. Enable it for instances that must not be deleted casually.

findings.title: EC2 instance without Nitro Enclaves enabled
findings.description: enclave_options is absent, so Nitro Enclaves are unavailable on this instance. Workloads that process sensitive data should enable enclave_options { enabled = true } to isolate it.
findings.remediation: Review the flagged configuration against AWS security best practices and the CIS AWS Foundations Benchmark. Apply the control the rule describes, preferring restrictive defaults, encryption, and audit logging. Validate with `aegis scan` after the change.
